spine.deviation_notes: The piercing cold bolt + chill/freeze lands via line geometry + water + the freeze/shatter pair, but Freezing Pulse's defining 'damage and freeze-chance DECAY with distance -- stand close for max output' has no matching 26-geometry (distance-falloff is a numeric projectile property the enum does not carry). A player keeps the piercing-cold-caster feel but loses the core positional discipline of hugging targets to hit the damage/freeze breakpoints before the pulse fades.

skills.delivery_notes: an icy projectile that PIERCES all enemies in a straight line and loses damage + freeze-chance the farther it travels (up to 50% less damage, freeze-chance gone after the first quarter of flight). line = straight-line piercing axis. water/cold family; chill (soft slow) + freeze (hard lock, native shatter payoff). The inverse 'closer = more damage / more freeze' decay is a behavioral property with no geometry-enum carrier

mapping_json.motion_frame: stationary cold caster: fire piercing pulses into a pack; standing close (or planting totems close) maximizes damage and freeze because the projectile decays fast with distance

economy: mana-mid spend; FP-Totem variant offloads casting to Spell Totems (Soul Mantle)

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PIERCING-DECAY projectile. Geometry: dossier is explicit -- 'projectile (straight line, piercing)', footprint 'narrow piercing line' -> line (not multi_projectile; it is ONE piercing bolt, not a fan). water/cold family; ailments chill+freeze (freeze's native shatter is a payoff for the cold theme). THE MISSED SIGNATURE: the projectile CONTINUOUSLY LOSES damage and freeze-chance with distance (50% less at max range, freeze gone after 25% of flight) -- 'closer = more' is the whole positional skill of the skill, and no 26-geometry carries a distance-decay damage falloff (it is a numeric/behavioral projectile property). ELEMENTAL_ECHO for the mono-cold amp; ZONE_CONTROL secondary (the chill/freeze lockdown reading). FP-Totem Hierophant (Soul Mantle) is a delivery-chassis variant that keeps the projectile identity; noted as a 'meme-build in earlier eras' per source.
